heads.u: ordinary physical attempt: unblocked versus block
heads.r: on-net, known immediate stop: goal or continuing save versus recorded stopped save
heads.g: on-net, known not stopped: goal versus continuing save; auxiliary setter mixture

definition.missingness: head-training applicable weighted mean; unavailable and structural absence distinct; constant indicators zero
definition.actors: tip-masked shooter; q/r/g goalie; g setter; separate known coach directions
definition.setter: .2 none,.8 role-weighted current unit and supported prior-clock phase participants; unknown phase unknown; current-skater linear mean

history_cutoff.selection: supported earlier source order AND strictly earlier period/game clock
history_cutoff.same_clock: ignore every row including faceoff, reset, review and unknown kind before examining its contents
history_cutoff.phase: coarsened recorded prior-clock proxy; current membership retained; no recovered physical uninterrupted-play claim
history_cutoff.period: history is within the focal period; known earlier periods are outside it, unknown prior period is a barrier
history_cutoff.phase_boundary: supported prior reset gives known absence; supported faceoff or action after a known reset starts a known recorded phase; unanchored live history is censored
history_cutoff.known_absence: empty known phase participants; complete current-unit-only proxy candidates
history_cutoff.unknown: unknown clock/order/kind or censored phase remains unavailable until a supported earlier reset/anchor
history_cutoff.transition: shared native membership algebra at strict before-clock query; includes interval returns r<t without intervening events, excludes r==t
history_cutoff.transition_evidence: supported native intervals plus selected earlier source reset/clock facts; no per-event elapsed association prerequisite

definition.history: entry OR carry; last likelihood-supported raw state; separate block/head/role age curves; no role-change reset
definition.reference: raw-minus-training-centers; preserve applicability offsets; virtual neutral execution

population.goalie_identity: q/r/g only: exact opposing-goalie member and supported dated team identity; optional reported position; conflicting positive credited/native ids withheld; u uses cardinality only
population.stop: v1-01 recorded_goalie_stop; unavailable withholds r/g only

fixed_transforms.recent_additive: fixed category indicators over last allowed earlier-source-order, strictly earlier-clock record; known none zeros
fixed_transforms.recent_interactions: unchanged fixed kind×same-team and kind×delay contrasts over strict prior-clock recent record
fixed_transforms.recent_geometry: candidate minus strict prior-clock preceding attacking coordinates; dx,dy,hypot/100; opposite nonzero y signs
fixed_transforms.off_wing: original reported right hand and candidate y>0, or left hand and y<0; supported centerline false
fixed_transforms.sequence: persistent defender index2,index3,index4+ indicators and age/60; index1 reference
fixed_transforms.shift_age: original shooter and complete actual opposing-unit min,mean,max compatible shift ages/60
fixed_transforms.shift_start: on_the_fly reference; faceoff offensive,neutral,defensive; unknown unavailable; last-faceoff existence,zone,age/60
fixed_transforms.workload: shooter prefix toi/3600,completed shifts/30,attempts/10; complete actual opposing-unit mean,max prefix toi/3600; shooter7,14-day toi/3600,shifts/30,attempts/10
fixed_transforms.calendar_rest: shooter then opposing team: prior exists,gap days,prior-one/two-date,7/14-day games; proven no prior gap0
fixed_transforms.strength_transition: shared genuine unequal-strength→5v5 membership history evaluated strictly before focal clock; previous fewer/more and return age/60; known none zeros

adaptations.unit: all actual opposing members; no known-only sums
adaptations.shift_start: on_the_fly reference; faceoff offensive/neutral/defensive; unknown unavailable
adaptations.recent_geometry: candidate origin; none absent; unavailable predecessor unavailable
adaptations.team_rest: feature_history._team_rest; verified complete prepared current-season inventory only
adaptations.goalie_prefix: all supported earlier actions including penalty shots; never focal or later actions
adaptations.source_support: supported segment/event membership and candidate occurrences; coaches in dated assignments

missingness_definition.numeric: head-training mean among available applicable transformed values, weighted by frozen origin mass
missingness_definition.unavailable: centered zero plus one shared condition indicator
missingness_definition.structural_absence: centered zero plus declared existence/category indicator
missingness_definition.categories: fixed ordered contrasts with separate unavailable indicator
missingness_definition.unsupported_or_constant_indicator: zero coefficient and explicit training support
missingness_definition.unknown_coach: no actor identity; unavailable circumstance; known-only center applicability

availability_conditions.preceding_status_rule: one shared unavailable indicator; producer status recent requires complete applicable preceding facts; none remains structural absence
availability_conditions.strength_transition_rule: one shared unavailable indicator; strict query returns known side and age together when a return exists, known structural absence when none exists, otherwise all unavailable
availability_conditions.independent_fields: separate supported selected counter/sequence fields retain their own availability; do not group empirical co-missingness

setter_definition.candidate_universe: current teammates plus every supported strictly prior-clock phase event's attacking unit and named participants, excluding shooter; known absent phase is empty, unknown/censored phase -> unknown
setter_definition.known_assist: likelihood-only local candidate position; never enlarge universe
setter_definition.unknown_or_goalie: fixed pre-outcome skater candidate-weighted current linear mean; differentiate coupling
setter_definition.objective: sum origin weights times negative log branch mixture, not log origin mixture

age_definition.transition: last-supported raw + (z(current_age)-z(last_age)) dot current annual block/head/role curve

definition.role_definition: actual typed goalie membership supports G without biographical position; conflicting goalie/skater membership or dated position makes role unknown; F/D requires supported dated position; reasons retained

history_definition.returning: carry around declared mean only, no additional level ridge
history_definition.ledger: only likelihood-supported completed state updates; absent and prior-only years preserve last observation
history_definition.zero_likelihood: analytic current prior mean after age estimation
history_definition.centers: included pre-outcome opportunity weights; exclude tips for shooter, unknown coaches, none/unknown/goalie setters
history_definition.setter_mean_coupling: actual derivative support; reference weights alone not support

starts: current actor prior means, other terms zero
em_definition.select: minimum completed exact objective; zero start wins exact tie

scope: new-source contract only; old artifacts and scientific verdicts preserved; no compatible-old-recipe fallback
